notes.title: A Huge update is on it's way...
notes.content:
After quite some time, we're excited to announce that we're on the works of huge improvements to all aspects of Spaceport Hope! We're fixing, improving, adding and redesign in order to improve vastly what the game has to offer. It goes a bit further from an actual update and we consider it a standalone project, which includes the visual improvement of everything, better enemies and bosses, more stuff to do and improved gameplay experience.
You can join the new thread about the update to share your thoughts and be up to date about the it's progress!
([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/394540/discussions/0/1699415798759316416/]Discussion thread[/url])

Here's a small pick from the updated visuals from the town area
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/m2g4dirrqntdis2/sh_post_1.png[/img]

notes.title: External Visions - progress update
notes.content:
Hallo everyone!

This post is a progress update for our new under-development game, External Visions. Although the original plans were to release the game this June - July the release will be delayed a bit more (just a little). That's all for good though, because this extra time we have been working exclusively on gameplay improvement and adding new content! So while the game is feature complete, we'll keep making additions and improvements for a little more time.
We'll make sure keep you up-to-date of our progress with future posts :)

Here's a photo from a newly added puzzle room:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/t9iri7u9q1h51k4/1501841381759.png[/img]

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update
notes.content:
The latest update fixes the launcher of the game to work correctly with 32 bit systems and removes the lag that some players had the first time a sound was loaded.

The update also improves the performance of the game a bit.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update
notes.content:
This update is focused on making the game more stable

-Fixed game crashing on some users with Windows 10 and Intel HD graphics
-Fixed game crashing from limited heap size
-Fixed levels appearing white
-Java is no longer required to launch the game
-Fixed some issues with enemy HP when changing difficulty

notes.title: Update Changelog
notes.content:
Chagelog:
-Fixed various issues that appeared when playing on expert or easy difficulty
-Balanced some bosses and enemies
-Small fix for hackers who said wrong dialogue
-Fixed players getting stuck when moving/sliding by shooting in the other direction
-Fixed crashing
-Some improvements to controller support
-Some enemy rellocations

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Minor Update
notes.content: This update includes a bug fix and improvements for the prison boss

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.8
notes.content:
Spaceport Hope v1.4.8 is now available and includes the following additions:

-Added a difficulty setting in the options menu. There are three different difficulty levels: Easy, Normal and Expert.
-Adjusted the movement of some flying enemies that were annoying and hard to hit
-Minor addition in tutorial level: Added ammo pickups and a sign to indicate them
-Added 'Escape' as shortcut key to return from menus.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Minor Update
notes.content: This is a small update that removes the gun heating from the game because it was judged unnecessary and had a negative impact on the gameplay.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.6
notes.content:
Spaceport Hope v1.4.6 is now available and includes fixes for the following issues:
 
-fixed sound bug that caused some of the sounds to play in mono channel
-fixed a glitch that allowed you to skip a part of the game
-addressed a small bug with bosses in slums area

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Achievement Update
notes.content: This update includes a fix for losing obtained achievements when reinstalling the game. Achievements now are synced correctly with the Steam client.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.5
notes.content:
Spaceport Hope v1.4.5 is now available and includes fixes for some bugs:

-fixed important texture issue. Users affected by this issue would get missing, black, noisy or distorted textures in various places.
-fixed blur background in menus, while using the non-streched fullscreenmode.
-small improvement in loading speed

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Minor Update
notes.content: Uppon the multiple requests of the game's players, this update makes the lockpick item permanent; hence you can use it multiple items. It was not clear that this is a one-time item and many users had trouble with this, so we changed this. Some minor tweaks and fixes are included also in the update.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.3
notes.content:
Spaceport Hope v1.4.3 is now uvailable and includes the following changes/additions: 

-better controller support, fixed some controller related bugs and crashes
-fixed some issues that made the game open with black window and crash
-improvements in some enemy AI
-various enemy additions/rellocations in some levels
-added second checkpoint in mainframe
-small balances
-only infinity icon is displayed for first gun (bullet icon was confusing for some users)

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.2
notes.content:
Spaceport Hope v1.4.2 is now uvailable and includes the following changes/additions:

-fixed issue with controllers that will make the hero continue to move/shoot after keys are released
-fixed dialogue getting out of the box in the last cutscene, as well some z-indexing problems with the dialogue box
-fixed wrong collision in council room
-fixed wrong hint after turning the power on
-fixed small issue with achievement unlocking
-fixed issue with health packs not working on some cases

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.0
notes.content:
Major update!
Spaceport Hope v1.4.0 is now uvailable and includes the following changes/additions:

-Improved dialogues for some npcs
-Redesigned puzzles for mainframe area
-Additions, object relocations and gameplay improvements for the drug 
-New track fr slus area + some improvements in the other tracks
-Changes in prison level for better difficulty balance with the rest levels
-Added new sound effects in some areas and objects
-Better support for fullscreen
-Added extra npc in town
-More balanced enemy/boss healths
-Fixed two achievements that didnt work, and could not be obtainedfactory and mainframe areas
-Fixed small typos

Support for OSX is sheduled for an update next week!
